comments.author: @Tracer414
comments.text:
It's funny I just saw this video. Just the other day I sent this email to American Airlines: 
American Airlines, once a quality carrier, has fallen to an unacceptable level. My recent Dallas-to-Burbank flight, AA2597, was horrific. With temperatures near 110°F in Dallas, we boarded an extremely hot aircraft. Passengers were sweating profusely; the young woman next to me was so miserable she rested her head on the tray table. Flight attendants repeatedly apologized for the heat and even used safety cards to fan themselves during the safety briefing. Virtually no cool air was coming from the overhead vents. Whether the APU was unavailable or the ground AC Cart was not connected, passengers should NEVER be subjected to extreme cabin temperatures like this. Combined with constant delays and last-minute gate changes, this experience reinforces why I instruct my company’s travel agency and associates to avoid American Airlines whenever possible. American has unfortunately become an airline of last resort.
